_comment: The submission narration, one entry per beat, consumed by video/generate-narration.py from _submission_kit/repos/submission-kit/video. captionText is what a viewer reads and carries the exact names and figures a judge will check. speechText is the same sentence spelled the way a text to speech engine pronounces it: SHA256 becomes S H A two five six, IAM becomes I A M, offer-4471 becomes offer four four seven one. Nothing is said here that is not true of the deployed fleet today.
_comment_length: The pipeline refuses a whole video outside 90 to 174 seconds and refuses any beat outside 3 to 40. These seven are drafted at roughly 150 seconds at a normal pace, which leaves room in both directions. That number is a draft and not a measurement: run the generator once and read the total it prints, then cut or add words. Our own docs/video-script.md targets 4:30, which this pipeline will not accept, and that collision is written into STATE.md rather than left to surface on recording day.

segments._beat: The problem, in the buyer's words. A named segment, never a market.
segments.captionText: Five small charities in one Athens neighbourhood share whatever food gets donated. A pantry, a night shelter, a school, a library, a soup kitchen. None of them employs anybody to do this. An offer arrives in a group chat and whoever answers first takes it, so two vans drive to the same pallet, and in March nobody can say what happened in September.

segments._beat: The surface the buyer already opens. Not another dashboard.
segments.captionText: The decision arrives in the group chat they are already in. Merismos writes it out for them: who receives what, and who was skipped with the rule that decided it, in the words a coordinator would send. They select it and send it. No new habit, and no twelfth tab anybody has to remember to open.

segments._beat: What fires without anyone asking, and the bound on it.
segments.captionText: Pressing a button is not the only way a run starts. A specialist that cannot settle something today parks it with a date, and on that date an EventBridge one-shot wakes the fleet and deletes itself. That path may only add a note to the record. A trigger that fires unattended and can also publish is not a feature.

segments._beat: How the sponsor's product is load-bearing, proven by removing it.
segments.captionText: Every refusal in this fleet happens inside the Strands tool dispatcher. A hook sets cancel_tool and the tool is never invoked. Take the SDK away and one command requires the demo to stop working. It caught us out: the offline path had no agent at all, so the claim was true of the repository and false of what you would run.

segments._beat: What a judge can check without asking us.
segments.captionText: You can check all of it without us. The published record is a public address anyone opens with no account. The approval binds a sha256 that a different identity recomputes from the bytes that arrive. And the identity serving the page is refused that write by IAM, which it proves by attempting it.
